clusters.description:
Reading: Component(s).Tail -[is part of]-> Cat.Whole.

Tail end — role: Component, multiplicity 0..1
(a Cat has at most one Tail (1) — multiple tails are out of scope —
but tailless cats do exist, hence the lower bound of 0.)

Cat end — role: Composite, multiplicity 1 (default, not shown)
(a Tail belongs to exactly one Cat — always.
A Tail cannot exist without its Cat.)

Composition semantics (filled diamond):
This is a composite aggregation — the strongest ownership in UML.
The Tail cannot exist independently of the Cat:
if the Cat is put outside, the Tail goes with it.
If you see a tail in the doorway and pull it,
a meowing Cat will inevitably follow.
A Tail may belong to at most one Cat at any point in time.

Direction of reading is shown on the diagram by a filled triangle
next to the association name label.
The association direction itself is Unspecified.
